title: SubmitRunAck
description: The 202 Accepted response to POST /runs: the accepted job's id and the URLs to observe it. The run itself proceeds on a background task; poll `statusUrl` for its outcome and stream `eventsUrl` for live harness events.

jobId.description: The id of the accepted run job. The status and events endpoints key on it.

statusUrl.description: Where to poll the job's status (`/runs/{jobId}`), relative to the worker's base URL.

eventsUrl.description: Where to stream the job's live harness events as NDJSON (`/runs/{jobId}/events`), relative to the worker's base URL.
